title: RNA Isolation from Plant Tissue Using CTAB-Hot Acid Phenol Method
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.4uygwxw
materials: Invert tubes and air dry at room temperature.
Extract once with hot acid phenol.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Preheat phenol and phenol:chloroform to 65 °C. Ensure heated phenol is not re-used.

steps.title: Collect Algae Cells
steps.instruction: Collect algae cells via centrifugation for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Initial Extraction
steps.instruction: Re-suspend the frozen pellet in 800 µL of preheated extraction buffer.

steps.title: Incubate Sample
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample at 65 °C for 1 hour, gently vortexing every 15 minutes.

steps.title: Cool Sample
steps.instruction: Cool the sample to room temperature.

steps.title: First Aqueous Phase Collection
steps.instruction: Collect the aqueous phase by centrifuging for 10 minutes in a micro-centrifuge at room temperature.

steps.title: Chloroform Re-extraction
steps.instruction: Collect the aqueous phase and re-extract with an equal volume of chloroform.

steps.title: LiCl Addition
steps.instruction: Collect the aqueous phase and add 10 M LiCl to a final concentration of 3 M.

steps.title: RNA Recovery
steps.instruction: Recover the RNA by centrifugation at 4 °C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Dissolve Pellet
steps.instruction: Dissolve the pellet in DEPC treated water.

steps.title: Phenol:Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract the aqueous phase with an equal volume of phenol:chloroform (5:1) and vortex for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract the aqueous phase with an equal volume of chloroform.

steps.title: Precipitation Preparation
steps.instruction: Collect the aqueous phase and add 1/30 volume of 3 M sodium acetate pH 5.5 and 0.1 volume of 100% ethanol.

steps.title: Secondary Precipitation
steps.instruction: To the clear supernatant, add 3 M sodium acetate pH 5.2 to a final concentration of 0.3 M and 3 volumes of 100% ethanol.

steps.title: Centrifuge RNA
steps.instruction: Spin in a micro-centrifuge at 4 °C at top speed for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Wash and Resuspend
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 70% ethanol and resuspend pellets in 50 µL of DEPC treated water.

steps.title: Storage
steps.instruction: Flash freeze pellets with liquid nitrogen and keep at -80 °C until extractions are carried out.

steps.title: Final Purification
steps.instruction: Perform final purification steps to remove polysaccharides.

substeps.instruction: Shake vigorously until 2 phases form an emulsion
Allow RNA to precipitate at 4 °C overnight
Spin for 5 minutes in a micro-centrifuge at top speed
Mix well and keep on ice for 30 minutes
Discard the white jelly-like pellet consisting mostly of polysaccharides

steps.title: Final Precipitation
steps.instruction: Allow the RNA to precipitate at -80 °C for 3 hours to overnight.
